subject: pink pig on display stand with small wings
concept: A chunky pink pig with a round body, snout, and floppy ears, sitting calmly with two small white wings attached at the sides. The whole model is mounted on a clear tilted display stand so it appears to hover.
features: round pink body with a big rounded snout (round plate on the front)
two triangular pink ears made from slopes
two chunky white wings attached at the sides with hinges
short curly tail simplified to 1-2 small pink bricks
clear tilted display stand under the belly
simplifications: Flying mid-air becomes hovering on a clear tilted display stand, since free flight and balance cannot be built.
Flapping wings become static wings on side hinges set at one fixed angle, because motion is not buildable.
Curly tail becomes 1-2 small bricks, since thin curved structures are not buildable.
Realistic pig face becomes two round-plate eyes and a round-plate snout, since detailed faces need printing or many angles.
Four legs and hooves become short stubby brick legs, or are hidden entirely by the stand, to keep the silhouette simple and stable.
